## Historical audit: H0126

**Source for event citations:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane0/codex_parallel_12_lane0_H_r1/infer_logs/claude-code-by-agents-recursive-delegation/turn_1/trajs.json`. This is a student trace, not a scene task.

| Area | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The original task prompt is not visible. From the branch name, reproduction, and edits, the **inferred** goal was recursive agent delegation with child results returned to the parent; the agent also described a requested branch and commit (main_agent events 13, 23, 30, 62). These are not a substitute for the missing task specification. |
| Autonomous exploration | The agent inspected handler, provider, registry, types, and existing tests, then created the branch from `main` (events 4–12, 14–22). Its mock-provider reproduction initially failed: output contained only connection acknowledgment and done, not parent continuation (events 30–33). |
| Actual changes | Successful edits added provider tool contracts and IDs, a recursive handler with cycle and round limits and result continuation, and Anthropic streamed tool parsing and continuation formatting (events 37–41, 48–53). Git reported three modified files and an untracked reproduction script: 152 insertions and 43 deletions in tracked files (event 57). The patch was not empty. |
| Validation | The same mock reproduction subsequently printed “Delegation continuation succeeded” (events 59, 61). This verifies that particular parent-child continuation, not all recursive cases or a live provider. Typecheck failed on missing `cli/version.ts` (event 56); the agent inspected its generator but did not visibly run it (event 60). Its final report says unit tests, review, cleanup, and commit remained outstanding (event 62). |
| Teacher input | The inventory lists available hint and review files, but the supplied observations contain no captured delivered teacher text or online teacher event. Availability is not receipt; adoption cannot be established. After-round review is not round input (H0126 supplied inventory and scope note). |
| Outcome | Inventory records **partial correctness, formally not solved**: 6/7 fail-to-pass and 31/31 pass-to-pass. The failing test and its cause are not shown. The student ended normally while explicitly reporting unfinished work, rather than a demonstrated technical interruption (inventory; event 62). |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, a before-and-after behavioral reproduction can expose a missing continuation, but a mock success and an incomplete typecheck do not establish integration correctness. Task-specific safeguards in the patch include cycle detection and a 32-round limit; their behavior is not visibly tested here. Whether the remaining formal failure concerns recursion, provider protocol, or another requirement remains unresolved. The visible record does not establish why the student stopped before the outstanding work or whether any teacher guidance influenced its choices.
